answers.question: How do I book a test drive?
answers.answer: Test drives are free, last up to 30 minutes and are booked with a sales advisor. Bring a valid driving licence on the day. I can pass your name, contact preference and the car you are interested in to the sales team.

answers.question: What warranty comes with a new car?
answers.answer: New Fakeford vehicles include a 3-year / 60,000-mile manufacturer warranty.

answers.question: How long is the battery warranty on an electric car?
answers.answer: The battery on new electric Fakeford vehicles, such as the Voltaire, is covered for 8 years / 100,000 miles.

answers.question: What warranty comes with a used car?
answers.answer: Used vehicles include a 12-month warranty. You can upgrade to 24 months for GBP 150 (offer OFF-004).

answers.question: Can I return a car?
answers.answer: You can return a vehicle within 14 days or 500 miles for an exchange or refund, subject to inspection. Refunds are handled by the finance team.

answers.question: How often should my petrol, diesel or hybrid car be serviced?
answers.answer: Every 12 months or 10,000 miles, whichever comes first.

answers.question: How often should my electric car be serviced?
answers.answer: Electric vehicles are serviced every 24 months or 18,000 miles, whichever comes first.

answers.question: How do I book a service?
answers.answer: Contact the Service Desk on +44 0000 000002 or service@fakeford-motors.example.com. I can also note a service request (name, contact preference, vehicle and preferred week) for a service advisor to confirm.

answers.question: Who do I call if my new car breaks down?
answers.answer: New vehicles include 12 months of roadside assistance. Call Fakeford Assist on +44 0000 000001. Used vehicles do not include roadside assistance.

answers.question: What are your opening hours?
answers.answer: Showroom: Monday to Friday 09:00-18:00, Saturday 09:00-17:00, closed Sunday. Service department: Monday to Friday 08:00-17:30, Saturday 08:30-12:30, closed Sunday.

answers.question: What finance is available on the Nomad or Trekker?
answers.answer: New Nomad and Trekker models have a representative 5.9% APR with a 10% deposit over 48 months, subject to status and credit checks by our fictional lender (offer OFF-002).

answers.question: Do you install home EV chargers?
answers.answer: We sell a 7 kW home charger (ACC-003, GBP 650) on a supply-only basis. Installation must be arranged separately with a qualified installer.

answers.question: How do I make a complaint?
answers.answer: Email complaints@fakeford-motors.example.com. We acknowledge complaints within 2 working days and send a full response or update within 10 working days.

answers.question: Is the Trekker SE all-wheel drive?
answers.answer: No. The Trekker SE is front-wheel drive. Only the Trekker Adventure AWD (FM-006) has all-wheel drive.

answers.question: What is included with the free first service offer?
answers.answer: The first scheduled service is free on any new vehicle (offer OFF-003). Book it through the Service Desk.

answers.question: Can I get a courtesy car while my car is serviced?
answers.answer: For work expected to take under 3 hours you can wait in our customer lounge. For longer work a free courtesy car is available subject to availability; book at least 48 hours ahead and bring a valid driving licence.
